newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MCCOIST DOUBLE GIVES RANGERS THEIR FIRST WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MCCOIST DOUBLE GIVES RANGERS THEIR FIRST WIN.

text.p: Ally McCoist scored twice on Wednesday as Glasgow Rangers claimed their first win in the European Cup Champions' League for three and a half years.
They beat Grasshopper Zurich 2-1 to collect their first points in group A.
McCoist, Rangers's top scorer in Europe, gave his side the lead from the penalty spot after 66 minutes.
The veteran striker scored again six minutes later.
Grasshopper skipper Mats Gren saw his 74th minute penalty saved by Andy Goram before Jan Berger volleyed home the Swiss side's goal two minutes later.
